edcoModel.name: Understand
edcoModel.summary: Use data, intelligence and research to understand where needs exist.

edcoModel.name: Engage
edcoModel.summary: Put it in front of the right people.

edcoModel.name: Build
edcoModel.summary: Turn engagement into relationships, leads and pipeline.

edcoModel.name: Grow
edcoModel.summary: Strengthen and expand the relationships you’ve already earned.

beliefs.title: Start with what educators need.
beliefs.body: Your product is fascinating to you. Their problem is fascinating to them.

beliefs.title: Listen before you assume.
beliefs.body: Thirty-five years in education has taught us many things. One of them is to keep asking questions.

beliefs.title: Give to receive.
beliefs.body: Be useful before you ask someone to buy something.

beliefs.title: Partnership is demonstrated, not claimed.
beliefs.body: Putting “trusted education partner” on your homepage doesn’t make you one.

beliefs.title: Relevance beats volume.
beliefs.body: Sending the wrong message to more schools doesn’t make it more right.

beliefs.title: Data is the foundation. Understanding is the value.
beliefs.body: A database can tell you who exists. Intelligence helps you understand who matters.

beliefs.title: Make friends before you make leads.
beliefs.body: People are considerably more receptive to organisations they already value.

beliefs.title: Better relationships build better pipeline.
beliefs.body: Yes, we said pipeline. This is ultimately about helping good organisations sell more.

beliefs.title: Winning a customer is the beginning, not the end.
beliefs.body: There’s often more opportunity among the organisations that already know you than those that don’t.

beliefs.title: Good advice sometimes means saying “don’t do that”.
beliefs.body: If we think a proposed campaign is a bad idea, we’d rather say so before the money is spent.

beliefs.title: Your objectives become our objectives.
beliefs.body: We’re more interested in what you’re trying to achieve than which bit of EdCo we can sell you.

beliefs.title: Technology should enable the relationship, not become the story.
beliefs.body: Nobody built a better relationship with a school because they had an impressive tech stack.

routes.objective: We want to become known for SEND
Our sales team needs better conversations
We need to understand why customers are leaving
We want relationships before people are ready to buy
